_doc: Ground colours for panels (style bible §3). A panel's "ground" is one of these names, or a hex. A panel's "sky" (above the horizon) takes the same names. Artist's rule (2026-11-08): backgrounds are light — off-white (light beige), light-grey, even white; greens only for top views (03.01) and the land strip under a sky/horizon (05.11); dusty-pink never.
